title: ScribeKey skill frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of a catalog SKILL.md. Agent Skills requires metadata values to be strings, so lists are comma- or space-separated text, never YAML arrays. CI still runs node scripts/skills.mjs check (folder name, version bump, index freshness).

name.description: Skill identity. Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. Must match the folder name.

description.description: What it does, then when to use it. The first sentence is the line under the skill's name.

compatibility.description: Optional Agent Skills field. Environment the skill expects.

allowed-tools.description: Optional experimental Agent Skills field. Space-separated tool names. ScribeKey never runs tools.

metadata.description: String keys to string values only, per the Agent Skills spec.

version.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Bump on every change so installed copies get Update.

scribekey-title.description: Display name. Default is the name humanised.

scribekey-apps.description: Android package names, space-separated. A string, not a YAML list.

scribekey-categories.description: email, messaging, or both, space- or comma-separated.

scribekey-discovery-categories.description: Discovery topics, space- or comma-separated: writing, search, productivity, developer-ai, languages.

scribekey-suggested-fields.description: Field kinds for suggestion ordering only, space- or comma-separated. Current value: search.

scribekey-actions.description: rewrite (in place), make (Studio result), or rewrite,make. A string, not a YAML list.

scribekey-presentation.description: How Studio shows a Make result. Default text.

scribekey-icon.description: Marketplace and tile glyph. Related skills share a glyph; omit for auto_awesome.

scribekey-output-format.description: MIME type a Make result is stored as. Default text/markdown.

scribekey-requires.description: Optional capability the host must have, kept as written.

scribekey-inputs.description: Path to a bundled JSON file declaring a Make run's inputs (a JSON Schema subset of string and boolean properties).
